QuestInfo.name: The Nightmare
QuestInfo.0: You've been having the same nightmare every night. You must have a lot on your mind.
QuestInfo.1: You've been having the same nightmare every night. You must have a lot on your mind. Maybe some fresh air will help.
QuestInfo.2: You went for a late night walk through the alleys of the city. It's awfully noisy here...

0.0: It's that dream again. The same nightmare every day... Dim visions of running down a castle hall and escaping into the night...\r\n
0.1: And it's only gotten worse. Some nights it feels like I can't even breathe.\r\n
0.2: The hideout feels claustrophobic today... I need to go outside for some air.\r\n

yes.0: If I'm going to meet the boss when I said I would, I'll need to get out of this room.\r\n

no.0: I know I'm forgetting something... I should go look for it.\r\n

1.0: This whole city is a cesspool. I'm not sure why I thought things would be--or smell--any different out here.

default.0: The hideout feels claustrophobic today... I need to go outside for some air.\r\n
